executable probes and result receipts identify tested versions, exact operations, observed semantics, missing capabilities and any required upstream patches.

gates.note: Feasibility evaluation recorded, including explicit no-go for Basic Debugging qualification until HALT-safe execution is proven. Probe PASS does not pass mGBA capabilities or Release B.

gates.requirement: record a go/no-go decision for mGBA Basic Debugging. If it cannot meet the minimum, Release A may continue; Release B remains incomplete until an evidence-backed second backend is selected and passes M8. Do not add more candidates without resolving the failed requirement.

gates.requirement: source history is reachable or explicitly retained in the source bundle; every imported supported file matches the source hash before subsequent edits.

gates.requirement: all exclusions/relocations have recorded reasons and license provenance. No duplicate SM83 language or study implementation appears.
gates.note: Mechanical import verified byte-for-byte before later build/path changes; original source history is a merge parent.

gates.requirement: original static build and imported component tests run from their documented paths. No unexplained behavioral difference from M0.
gates.note: 46 relocated debugger tests pass with hashed baseline runtime dependencies; static implementation is unchanged and root/optional Java builds pass. Fresh dependency bootstrap/package isolation remains M3.

gates.requirement: clean static checkout builds/tests without emulator binaries, Python runtime setup, SDL, native compiler or debugger project dependency downloads.
gates.note: Clean static build: 456 tests, no debugger project/runtime/cache used. macOS arm64 execution; broader platform release acceptance remains separate.

gates.requirement: clean full checkout builds without neighboring GhiGBC/GhiBW3 repositories, absolute developer paths, stale build outputs or manually selected provider JAR filenames.
gates.note: Clean isolated full source build obtained canonical dependencies directly and built/tested 46 native cases plus both Java extensions, without sibling repositories.

gates.requirement: packages contain one static provider, no bundled compile-only provider copy, correct notices, no private assets, and a deterministic source/dependency manifest.
gates.note: Both macOS and Linux packages validated at the M3 source snapshot; Linux ran offline without build tools/system SDL. Later M4 changes require fresh release checks.

gates.requirement: root commands are documented and exercised from a fresh checkout and paths containing spaces. Existing public commands either work through thin delegates or have tested migration guidance.
gates.note: Root commands documented and exercised from clean source and a path containing spaces; legacy packagers delegate and explicit provider override remains verified.

gates.requirement: packaging identifies stock versus patched native decompiler requirements; the doctor detects mismatches and never silently overwrites an active Ghidra distribution.
gates.note: Packages declare the native decompiler identity; updater is included; marker/platform/hash mismatch checks and pre-install refusal pass without changing user directories.

gates.requirement: structural checks find no SameBoy headers/private fields outside its adapter, and no native handle/API access from generic agent/UI/display/profile code. Compatibility readers and labeled provenance may mention SameBoy.
gates.note: Native source isolated under its backend; shared session/agent/display contain no native handles/layouts; structural checks pass.

gates.requirement: run identical self-authored fixtures through the pre-extraction and new SameBoy paths; compare defined registers, physical bytes, stop reasons, event order/precision, bank mappings, edits and restore semantics.

gates.requirement: pause during run/queue saturation, timed-out requests, disconnect/reconnect, target exit, callback ordering, event overflow and shutdown have bounded behavior with visible error/loss reporting.

gates.requirement: display input, focus loss, minimized/paused pumping, frame copying and close work through the abstraction without stale held keys or lock inversion.

gates.requirement: boot/model selection and actual reported configuration agree; reject incompatible boot images and silent model fallback. Exercise true DMG and both CGB modes independently.

gates.requirement: preserve all existing exhaustive arithmetic/CB/stack/control-flow regressions and pinned external vectors; inventory all base/CB encodings and expand missing families. Report actual cases, undefined opcodes, masks and exclusions, not “100% CPU accuracy” from an opcode count.

gates.requirement: applicable hardware ROM suites exercise timers, interrupts/EI delay, HALT/STOP, bus restrictions, boot unmapping, CGB speed switching and DMA/HDMA behavior. A correct engine result does not prove the debugger's event attribution is correct; check those separately.

gates.requirement: a debug-instrumented run matches a pristine-core run for comparable defined state/output; nondestructive inspection leaves engine state unchanged; instrumentation patches cannot validate themselves solely through their own event output.

gates.requirement: cross-backend fixtures normalize model/boot/clock/input and compare defined registers/memory at explicit synchronization boundaries. Differences produce minimal reproducers and classified explanations, never majority-vote correctness or blanket suppression.
gates.note: Defined states match12 boundaries; source-classified speed-switch timing disagreement retained, comparison exit2, verifier tests PASS. Exact hardware/model/boot equivalence is not claimed.

gates.requirement: both backends run from extracted platform packages and pass resource, failure and cleanup gates. Mark experimental until its required tier passes on the named platform.
